properties.notes: Proposed allocation CR12a in Submission Draft Local Plan. This site will be developed for a mix of edge-of-centre retail uses, which may include bulky goods, and residential development, along with public car parking. The retail may include bulky goods, but should not include a significant element of non-bulky comparison goods retail, and must be designed to mesh into the urban fabric and a single storey retail warehouse will not be permitted.. http://www.reading.gov.uk/media/8649/LP001-Submission-Draft-Local-Plan/pdf/LP001_Submission_Draft_Local_Plan.pdf
